change.after: "update/delete policies apply only to the application itself"

consequence.statement: Users whose policies grant `update` or `delete` on an application lose that access to the application's sub-resources (managed resources) unless new `update/*` or `delete/*` policies are defined.
consequence.remediation: Define policies allowing `update/*` or `delete/*` on the Application's managed resources, or set server.rbac.disableApplicationFineGrainedRBACInheritance to false in argocd-cm to preserve v2 behavior.

assertion.statement: Starting in Argo CD 3.0, application `update` and `delete` RBAC policies no longer apply to sub-resources; the v2 behavior can be kept by setting server.rbac.disableApplicationFineGrainedRBACInheritance to false in argocd-cm.
